controls.observation: Publisher reuses the stored item UPI. Resolver uses HTTPS in production and generates SVG QR; existing settings are not a reviewed EN profile.
controls.remainingReview: Review identifier issuance, data-carrier clauses, continuity and migration cases. No abstract-derived syntax or QR margins.

controls.observation: Public resolver reads PublicPassportSnapshot and projects allowed public fields, rather than serving the canonical passport.
controls.remainingReview: Map reviewed access clauses and final Article 77(9) rules to audience-specific policies; public data must remain readable.

controls.observation: Capability tokens are hashed; grant validation checks tenant ownership, scope, expiry and revocation in the disclosure transaction.
controls.remainingReview: Review legitimate-interest eligibility, identity assurance, permitted reuse and responsibility transfer; current capability mechanism is not a normative conformity claim.

controls.observation: Evidence must pass actual-byte hash checks and applicable malware scanning before verified use; provenance and manual verification remain required.
controls.remainingReview: Map authenticated exchange requirements after full-text review. Content hashes alone do not establish origin/authenticity, ESDC conformity or issuer trust.

controls.observation: Publishing creates a canonical SHA-256 version and previous-version link. Database trigger protects published version mutation/deletion.
controls.remainingReview: Review authenticity, key/issuer trust, data-exchange constructs and retention/transfer; immutable local versions do not independently prove normative conformity.
